name: api_project_deliverables
_description: GET /api/v1/project-deliverables?id=X - devuelve outputs persistidos de los 4 agentes pre-launch para un proyecto: ultimo iee_reports approved, ultimo rcd_studies approved, ultimo output de agent_grants_finder, ultimo output de agent_telematic_filing. Usado por ProjectDeliverablesPanel.

parameters.query:
WITH ctx AS (SELECT set_session_context($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3) AS ok),
proj AS (
  SELECT projects.id AS project_id, projects.name, projects.location_city
  FROM projects, ctx WHERE projects.id = $4::uuid LIMIT 1
),
iee AS (
  SELECT iee_reports.id AS iee_id, iee_reports.calificacion_global,
         iee_reports.estado_conservacion, iee_reports.condiciones_accesibilidad,
         iee_reports.eficiencia_energetica, iee_reports.recomendaciones,
         iee_reports.draft_content, iee_reports.approved_at
  FROM iee_reports, proj
  WHERE iee_reports.project_id = proj.project_id
  ORDER BY iee_reports.approved_at DESC LIMIT 1
),
iee_dr AS (
  SELECT iee_reports_draft.id AS draft_id, iee_reports_draft.calificacion_global,
         iee_reports_draft.draft_content, iee_reports_draft.created_at
  FROM iee_reports_draft, proj
  WHERE iee_reports_draft.project_id = proj.project_id
    AND iee_reports_draft.status = 'draft'
  ORDER BY iee_reports_draft.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
),
rcd AS (
  SELECT rcd_studies.id AS rcd_id, rcd_studies.tipo_obra, rcd_studies.total_toneladas,
         rcd_studies.coste_gestion_eur, rcd_studies.alertas_peligrosos,
         rcd_studies.draft_content, rcd_studies.approved_at
  FROM rcd_studies, proj
  WHERE rcd_studies.project_id = proj.project_id
  ORDER BY rcd_studies.approved_at DESC LIMIT 1
),
rcd_dr AS (
  SELECT rcd_studies_draft.id AS draft_id, rcd_studies_draft.total_toneladas,
         rcd_studies_draft.coste_gestion_eur, rcd_studies_draft.alertas_peligrosos,
         rcd_studies_draft.created_at
  FROM rcd_studies_draft, proj
  WHERE rcd_studies_draft.project_id = proj.project_id
    AND rcd_studies_draft.status = 'draft'
  ORDER BY rcd_studies_draft.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
),
grants_exec AS (
  SELECT agent_executions.id AS exec_id, agent_executions.output, agent_executions.metadata, agent_executions.finished_at
  FROM agent_executions, proj
  WHERE agent_executions.project_id = proj.project_id
    AND agent_executions.agent_name = 'agent_grants_finder'
    AND agent_executions.status = 'completed'
  ORDER BY agent_executions.finished_at DESC LIMIT 1
),
telematic_exec AS (
  SELECT agent_executions.id AS exec_id, agent_executions.input, agent_executions.output, agent_executions.metadata, agent_executions.finished_at
  FROM agent_executions, proj
  WHERE agent_executions.project_id = proj.project_id
    AND agent_executions.agent_name = 'agent_telematic_filing'
    AND agent_executions.status = 'completed'
  ORDER BY agent_executions.finished_at DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  (SELECT row_to_json(proj)         FROM proj)         AS project,
  (SELECT row_to_json(iee)          FROM iee)          AS iee_approved,
  (SELECT row_to_json(iee_dr)       FROM iee_dr)       AS iee_draft,
  (SELECT row_to_json(rcd)          FROM rcd)          AS rcd_approved,
  (SELECT row_to_json(rcd_dr)       FROM rcd_dr)       AS rcd_draft,
  (SELECT row_to_json(grants_exec)  FROM grants_exec)  AS grants_last,
  (SELECT row_to_json(telematic_exec) FROM telematic_exec) AS telematic_last
